relevance_note: Case series of four individually described patients with GFAP mutations: "We report 4 AxD patients with an onset age older than 50 years".
method_note: Paper converted from PDF; read in full by hand. A short Python script assembled the JSON and cut table spans out of the Markdown table lines; its output was checked against the table. The single Table has patients as columns (header row 'Patient' with columns A, B, C, D); labels use the text's own form 'Case A'-'Case D'. Variants are printed only as protein one-letter strings (N386S, E210K, R258H, R70W) with no transcript or c. notation; recorded as printed in variant_original_string and protein_hgvs_as_stated. The symptom and MRI rows of the Table use the codes '1' and '2' (probably converted +/- signs), but the paper gives no legend defining them, so these cells were not used for any status (rule 6 / table-symbol rule); statuses come from the case texts. Consequently table-only items stay 'not reported': e.g. palatal tremor (all '2'), nystagmus for B and C ('1'), dysphagia for C ('1'), ataxia for C ('1'), weakness for B ('2'), autonomic dysfunction for D ('2'), dentate hilum and periventricular rows for A and C ('2'). Text says periventricular and dentate-hilum abnormalities 'were noted in cases B and D'; without 'only' this was not used to exclude them for A and C. 'Inferior olivary hypertrophy was not detected on MRI' does not name the group explicitly, so no excluded rows were made. Case D text says 'showing tendon reflexes' (no qualifier); not recorded as a feature, though bilateral Babinski sign supports pyramidal signs. Periventricular abnormality (B, D) was recorded as a feature but not mapped to the checklist items 'cerebral white matter abnormality' or 'periventricular rim', since the paper does not describe white matter or a rim. Medulla signal abnormality comes from the group statement 'observed in all patients' (4-patient series) and per-patient atrophy grades from the Table row 'Atrophy of medulla oblongata'. Age at diagnosis (65 for all) is from the Table; age at last evaluation (65) from the case texts' hospitalization/examination ages. Year 2015 taken from the copyright line. No contradictions found.
